name: RC-B10-0324/2025/REV1 – § 8 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text: 8. Urges the Commission and the Member States to accelerate the implementation of the CRMA; stresses the important role of the European Raw Materials Board and its sub-groups for the rapid and efficient implementation of the CRMA; recalls the clear and ambitious targets set to reinforce EU capacities to extract, process and recycle SRMs domestically by 2030; highlights the selection of the first 60 strategic projects under the CRMA; underlines that the selection procedure is lacking transparency and is conducted without consulting the affected populations; recalls the need to have broad approval among the affected populations when developing mining and industrial projects;
